items.quote: We recommend to use Ed25519 API keys as it should provide the best performance and security out of all supported key types.
items.why: Ed25519 recommendation is related key-type info, but not auth methods, header, or HMAC deprecation.

items.quote: We support HMAC, RSA, and Ed25519 keys. For more information, please see API Key types.
items.why: Lists supported key types only; no auth methods, header, or recommendation stated.

items.quote: API keys can be created on the API Management page of your Binance account.
items.why: Says keys are created on API Management page; no free-tier, 2FA, or deposit details.

items.quote: By default, an API key cannot `TRADE`. You need to enable trading in API Management first.
items.why: Trading disabled by default matches one detail; no key-creation or testnet gate stated.

items.quote: The limits on the API are based on the IPs, not the API keys.
items.why: Confirms rate limits are per IP; nothing on REST, WebSocket, or product breadth.

items.quote: Connect AI agents and coding assistants over the Model Context Protocol — for trading or for documentation lookup.
items.why: Describes MCP for agents; no vendor-official status or agent.binance.com URL shown.
